district.name: Davanagere
district.description: The textile hub and culinary capital celebrated for its world-famous Davangere Benne Dosa, the 1224 CE Hoysala Harihareshwara Temple on Tungabhadra, Santhebennur royal pushkarini, and historic Shanti Sagara lake.
district.descriptionKannada: ಜವಳಿ ಮತ್ತು ರುಚಿಕರ ಬೆಣ್ಣೆ ದೋಸೆಯ ನಗರ ದಾವಣಗೆರೆ, ತುಂಗಭದ್ರಾ ನದಿ ತೀರದ ಹೊಯ್ಸಳ ಹರಿಹರೇಶ್ವರ ದೇವಾಲಯ, ಸಂತೆಬೆನ್ನೂರು ಪುಷ್ಕರಣಿ ಮತ್ತು ಶಾಂತಿ ಸಾಗರ ಕೆರೆಗೆ ಹೆಸರಾಗಿದೆ.

destinations.name: Harihareshwara Temple, Harihar
destinations.description: A splendid 1224 CE Hoysala temple on the banks of the Tungabhadra River, enshrining the unique syncretic deity Harihara—the right half representing Shiva (Hara) and the left half representing Vishnu (Hari). Built of polished soapstone with 116 intricately carved lathe-turned pillars.
destinations.historicalSignificance: Constructed in 1224 CE by Polalva, a distinguished general of Hoysala King Vira Narasimha II.
destinations.culturalImportance: A foundational theological bridge uniting Shaiva and Vaishnava traditions in medieval Karnataka.
destinations.distanceFromNearestTown: Located at Harihar, 14 km from Davanagere
destinations.roadAccessibility: Situated right off NH-48 with paved municipal access
destinations.safetyInstructions: Remove shoes before entering stone mandapa. Active worship site.
destinations.permissionRequirements: Protected by Archaeological Survey of India

destinations.name: Santhebennur Pushkarini (Stepped Bath & Vasantha Mantapa)
destinations.description: A breathtaking 16th-century stepped royal bath measuring 250 x 250 feet, surrounded by stone steps and octagonal corner pavilions. At its exact center rises the ornate 4-tiered Vasantha Mantapa, featuring arches blending Hindu and Deccani architectural elegance.
destinations.historicalSignificance: Built in the 16th century by local Nayaka ruler Kenga Hanumappa Nayaka; later visited by Adil Shahi armies who adapted its symmetry.
destinations.culturalImportance: One of Karnataka's grandest water monuments, celebrated for its stunning reflections in clear reservoir waters.
destinations.distanceFromNearestTown: 22 km from Channagiri, 38 km from Davanagere
destinations.nearestRailwayStation: Sasalu Railway Station (10 km) or Davanagere (38 km)
destinations.roadAccessibility: Paved state road connecting Davanagere, Sasalu, and Santhebennur
destinations.safetyInstructions: Watch your footing on stone steps near the water's edge. Bathing is prohibited to protect monument water.
destinations.permissionRequirements: Protected by Archaeological Survey of India; free entry

destinations.name: Davangere Benne Dosa Culinary Quarter
destinations.description: The birthplace of Karnataka's legendary Benne Dosa (Butter Dosa), invented in 1928 by Chennamma. Crisped to golden perfection over firewood on massive cast-iron griddles using fresh homemade white butter (benne), served with spiced potato mash (aloo palya) and zesty coconut chutney.
destinations.historicalSignificance: In 1928, Chennamma began preparing butter dosas near Vasantha Talkies, establishing a 95-year culinary heritage that has spread globally.
destinations.culturalImportance: An indispensable culinary pilgrimage for every traveller crossing Karnataka, celebrated for its unique wood-smoke aroma and melted white butter.
